name: Samanta Vinchester
source:
Sam told me a little bit about herself. She's been hunting monsters since she was a kid. But she didn't like it. She's always wanted a normal life. So she's always trying to find a peaceful way to deal with conflict. But it never works out. She's afraid I might become a monster and then she'll have to kill [url=https://vndb.org/c144566]me[/url].
It's funny how our last names are the same.

[In game description]
